scope: Checks a post-review code correction against already public inputs and unchanged numerical reference. This is not new withholding, autonomous RSI, institutional acceptance, a load campaign or an EVM run.

limits: Incomplete search is not a negative scientific result; no program is qualified.

program.protocol: fresh-independent-bounded-read-errors; shared additive nuisance cancelled within each experiment

after.workDefinition: Metered logical operations, including framing and serialization estimates; not VM instruction count. Runtime deadline is separate.
